mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.0 and 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede a slowdown in corporate earnings and trigger negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5 and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1250 and RSAFS < 700000 and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 320), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0) signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 160000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing, which typically precedes economic slowdown and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 750000 and 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals unexpected monetary tightening, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.
